set.st: The Mount farm near Wyanet was where "old Bulbona" (Bourbonnais), a mixed-blood trader, his Indian wife and children lived and traded with the Indians. Mrs. Mount found a 1786 Spanish silver coin among her plants. Pin is between the two Mount farms on the 1875 atlas, not the spot itself.
set.t: A trading-post site: trade silver, coins, beads. Bulbona Grove is unlabelled on the 1875 atlas; the 1905 Bureau atlas (LoC) is still unread. Access: private: permission.
set.pl: Mount farms, NE sec 29 / W edge sec 28 T16N R8E, Wyanet Twp (1875 atlas); which Mount farm held the trading-post site is not said
pinev: 1875 Bureau Co atlas, Wyanet Twp T16N R8E: 'J. W. Mount 40' in the NE of sec 29 and 'Wm. Mount 80' on the W edge of sec 28, about 1.5 mi S/SW of Wyanet village; timber stippling runs along the creek E of the village. Pin on the 28/29 line between the two Mount tracts.
Bulbona Grove itself is unlabelled on the 1875 atlas
